ghidra_mutations: none; this worker was read-only against Ghidra. The write lock was held by agent/orch5-20260911 throughout.
summary: The four labelled stand-ins in docs/SHIP_MOTION.md are replaced by reconstructions: the rigid-body integrator (two outlined phases of the Dyn substep), the rudder curve settings producer (a Lua-driven settings loader) with the shipped values, the ocean height sampler, and the gameplay-modifier product. The hull body's own mass, inertia and damping and the library's substep size remain open.

substep_steps.name: Dyn_World_IntegrateVelocities
substep_steps.what: First phase of one substep: force to velocity with the inverse mass at M+50h, gravity unless B+50h bit 2, linear damping, the world inverse inertia rebuild, torque to angular velocity, angular damping, then the row-1 lock rebuild.

substep_steps.name: Dyn profiler scope label fetch
substep_steps.what: Fetches the rdtsc profiler scope whose image string is CreateGroups; the collision and constraint phases follow and are not read in this packet.

substep_steps.name: Dyn group build
substep_steps.what: contract: unread. Runs under the CreateGroups scope on world+448h.

substep_steps.name: Dyn profiler scope label fetch
substep_steps.what: Fetches the UpdatePosition scope label, which is how the next call is identified.

substep_steps.name: Dyn_World_IntegratePositions
substep_steps.what: Position from velocity plus bias, Rodrigues rotation of rows 2 and 1 with a Gram-Schmidt rebuild, damping again, the two speed clamps, the sleep countdown, and the clearing of the force, torque and bias accumulators.

substep_steps.name: Dyn group sleep
substep_steps.what: contract: unread. Runs under the SleepGroups scope.

schedule_steps.name: Dyn_World_Substep
schedule_steps.what: One full substep of world+00h, taken while the accumulator exceeds it and the budget at world+34h has not run out.

schedule_steps.name: Dyn_World_Substep remainder
schedule_steps.what: One partial substep of the leftover accumulator, taken when it exceeds the double 5.0e-5 at 00D7A398.

body_api.name: Dyn_Body_SetMass
body_api.what: M+50h = 1.0f/mass, so the stored field is the inverse mass. This is the debris-body call site; no hull-body call site was found.

body_api.name: Dyn_Body_SetInertia
body_api.what: M+54h/+58h/+5Ch = 1/I per axis, zero for a zero component. The inertia vector passed here is the body extent scaled by the mass set immediately before it.

body_api.name: BSP_GameWorld_SampleWaterHeight
body_api.what: The buoyancy loop's per-element water height; the consumer that settles the sampler's meaning as a world-space y.

ocean_steps.name: BSP_OceanWaveField_SampleHeight
ocean_steps.what: The wave field on [world+A8h]. Returns 0.0f when the byte at field+F9h is set; otherwise a sample of the object at field+BCh at the fractional parts of x and z scaled by field+B4h, times the amplitude at field+24h.
ocean_steps.coverage: partial: 00B960C0, the sample itself, is not read

ocean_steps.name: BSP_OceanWaveField_CoverageMask
ocean_steps.what: A 0..1 attenuation read from a per-region bitmap; exactly 1.0f when no region contains (x, z), which is the open-sea case.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_GameSettings_GetSingleton
settings_producer_steps.what: The first of four getter calls in 0082E890. It proves the rudder curve block is on the gameplay settings singleton, not on the unit.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_LuaObject_GetByName
settings_producer_steps.what: Fetches ShipGlobals[Navigator][TurnMultipliers] into the fragment's temporary.

settings_producer_steps.name: LuaObject assign
settings_producer_steps.what: contract: unread. Assigns that wrapper into the current-table slot at [ESP+0BCh], which is what makes the three key lookups run against the sub-table.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_LuaObject_GetByName
settings_producer_steps.what: Looks up TurnMultiplierMinSpeed on the sub-table.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_LuaObject_GetByIndex
settings_producer_steps.what: Index 1 of that array, the throttle coordinate.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_LuaObject_GetNumber
settings_producer_steps.what: lua_tonumber rounded to float in ST0; the caller FSTPs it to settings+444h at 0083CEDE.

settings_producer_steps.name: BSP_LuaObject_GetByIndex
settings_producer_steps.what: Index 2 of the same array, the turn-circle multiplier, stored to settings+440h at 0083CF4D.

modifier_steps.name: BSP_GameplayModifiers_ProductForUnit
modifier_steps.what: Category 4 for the reference speed, gated on the byte at 00E0C978 and on the list size at manager+B8h. When either gate fails the routine substitutes the same 1.0f at 00D7A24C that an empty list would produce.

modifier_steps.name: modifier filter
modifier_steps.what: contract: unread. Called with (node+8h, unit) and ECX = manager; a non-zero AL multiplies node[+1Ch] into the product at 008E647C.

probe.interpretation: The yaw halving is the shipped curve: the denominator at full throttle is 2.0, so the steady rate is MaxRotAngle/2. The speed differences follow from the slower turn, not from the integrator change: 0092D300 rewrites only the axial velocity component, so a tighter turn bleeds more speed into the lateral one.

corrections.target: docs/UNIT_CONTROLLER_UPDATE.md, the motion-state table and the 00C31FC0 row
corrections.was: M+50h is `float mass`; 00C31FC0 is `inverse mass: 0.0f when B+50h & 1, else 1.0f / M+50h`
corrections.is: M+50h is the inverse mass and 00C31FC0 returns the mass
corrections.evidence: 00C37F40 stores FLD1/FDIVRP of its argument into M+50h at 00C37F53, and 00C41550 forms M[+50h]*dt and multiplies the accumulated force by it, which is an acceleration only if the field is 1/m. 00C31FC0 returns the reciprocal of that field, and its FLDZ for a static body is the 1/0 guard. docs/GAME_DYNAMICS_LIST.md uses it as a mass independently: force = 00C31FC0(body) * 10.0 * submersion / record[+1Ch].

corrections.is: bit 2 suppresses the gravity term in the velocity phase
corrections.evidence: The bit's only reader is 00C41550, where a set bit skips `v += world.gravity * dt` and nothing else. The disabled controller path at 00932A16 reads as a freeze only because it zeroes both velocities before setting the bit.

corrections.was: Every physics entry point reached from the controller is a leaf: no callees, no strings, no source paths, no RTTI
corrections.is: The block has RTTI for several classes in a `Dyn` namespace
corrections.evidence: Dyn::Scene::LCPSolver2Task, TypeDescriptor 00E1736C, vtable 00D7A090 slot 0 at 00403850; also Dyn_ConvexRayIntersection_vslot0 (00C44780), Dyn_CylinderShape_vslot2 (00C47CA0) and Dyn_BoxBoxIntersect_vslot0 (00C49A30). The rest of that section (no middleware string, in-house library) stands.

corrections.was: Which handedness the three make is not established, so whether the row-0 term rights the hull or capsizes it is provisional
corrections.is: The triple is right-handed, and the row-0 term at 0092EA5B is a pitch limiter
corrections.evidence: 00C5B1B0 rebuilds the basis every rotating substep as row0 = normalise(row1 x row2) then row1 = row2 x row0, which is the right-handed identity set. Row 0 is therefore the lateral axis, and the damped angle 0042CF10(M21) at 0092E9E9 is the angle of row 2's vertical component, i.e. the pitch, pulled toward the +/-15 degrees at 00D19628. The sign of the correction still depends on the world's axis convention and stays provisional.

corrections.target: the packet brief, 'the rudder curve settings block at unit +438h..+44Ch'
corrections.was: a unit field, filled by an unrecovered producer with 00424C40 and the settings object's constructor as leads
corrections.is: a field of the gameplay settings singleton 00424C40 returns, filled by the Lua settings loader 0083B5E0
corrections.evidence: 0082E890 calls 00424C40 at 0082E893, 0082E8B0, 0082E8B7, 0082E8BE (and three more on the high branch) and reads +438h..+44Ch off each returned pointer; the routine takes no unit. A pass over 00424A10 finds no store into that range, and a byte-pattern scan of .text for a float store to each of the six offsets finds one writer of all six, inside 0083B5E0.

corrections.target: docs/SHIP_MOTION.md and docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md, 0078CF20 as an unread external contract
corrections.is: a two-call wrapper: the product of a wave field and a coverage mask on [world+A8h]
corrections.evidence: 0078CF20's body 0078CF20..0078CF76 calls 0078C890 at 0078CF3E and 00B9CF50 at 0078CF5F with the same (x, z) and the same receiver, spills the first as a double at 0078CF49, multiplies at 0078CF64 and rounds once at 0078CF69. A flat sea returning 0.0f is now evidenced (0078C890's FLDZ at 0078C89F, and the mask's 1.0f when no region covers the point) rather than assumed.

verification.limits: Nothing here is differentially tested against the executable. The two integration phases are transcribed from the decompiler with the listing consulted for the accessors, the flag bits and the constants; no instruction-level differential probe was run against them. x87 control-word precision is unmodelled, as in docs/SHIP_MOTION.md. No game validation.
